stories.title: Iran denies it was behind cyber fridge attacks targeting France
stories.description: The denial comes a day after the French government blamed Iranian military hackers for last month's attack on refrigeration systems at around 700 retail sites, which spoiled millions of dollars' worth of food.

stories.description: The president says the US is keeping "status quo" with Iran but remains “locked and loaded” should the situation change.

stories.description: Democrats' resounding victory could lead to a more critical approach to the Iran war in the next congress, Yolande Knell reports.

stories.title: 'I couldn't be silent': Iranian teen's mother seeking justice after daughter shot dead
stories.description: BBC Panorama follows grieving Samira who - after the killing of Sevda - faces up to the Tehran regime.

stories.title: US embassy refutes Houthis’ Yemen blockade claims, highlights siege on Taiz

stories.description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian is in Antalya, Turkiye, to participate in the 31st UN Climate Change Conference (COP31). He will also engage in discussions with other country leaders and officials.
